findings.current: “Don’t let him go anywhere near my brothers. Understood?”
findings.defect: The translation omits that Jin Mukyung and Jin Taekyung are Wikyung’s younger brothers, losing the stated kinship hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 아우들 specifically means younger brothers, not brothers generally.
findings.replacement: “Don’t let him go anywhere near my younger brothers. Understood?”
findings.source: “내 아우들 근처에 얼씬거리지 못하게 해. 알았나!”

findings.current: Personal preferences were one thing, but he had no desire to become the object of someone else’s.
findings.defect: The translation removes the explicit sexual qualifier from 성적 취향 and leaves the second clause with an awkward, incomplete possessive.
findings.rationale: 성적 취향 explicitly means sexual preference, while 그 대상 refers to becoming the target or object of that preference.
findings.replacement: Personal sexual preferences were one thing, but he had no desire to be the object of them.
findings.source: 개인적인 성적 취향이야 그렇다 쳐도, 그 대상이 되는 건 사양이었다.

findings.current: He felt as though he might cry from the anger and humiliation he was experiencing for the first time in his life.
findings.defect: Humiliation replaces 서러움, which conveys sorrow and wounded resentment rather than embarrassment or loss of dignity.
findings.rationale: 서러움 is the aggrieved sadness of feeling hurt or unfairly treated; preserving it maintains the comic emotional beat.
findings.replacement: For the first time in his life, anger and wounded sorrow brought him close to tears.
findings.source: 그는 난생처음 느껴 보는 분노와 서러움에 눈물이 날 것 같았다.

findings.defect: The draft turns one command into two and adds an unsupported “Stop!”
findings.rationale: 하지 마 is one command meaning “don’t do it,” followed separately by 바치지 마, “don’t offer it.”
findings.replacement: “No. Don’t do it! Don’t offer it!”

findings.current: Jin Mukyung stared at me with lowered eyes.
findings.defect: Lowered eyes suggests that Mukyung is looking downward, whereas 가라앉은 describes his gaze as subdued, grave, or somber.
findings.rationale: The source describes the emotional quality of his gaze, not a downward eye movement.
findings.replacement: Jin Mukyung fixed me with a somber gaze.

findings.defect: “A chill voice followed” is an unnatural English collocation and obscures that the same speaker continues.
findings.rationale: 이어졌다 indicates continuation, while 서늘한 characterizes the voice as cold or chilling.

findings.current: The martial arts I’ve performed more than a thousand, ten thousand times feel unfamiliar.
findings.defect: The quantity construction is ungrammatical and fails to convey the escalating sense of thousands and even tens of thousands of repetitions.
findings.rationale: 천 번, 만 번도 넘게 is an escalating expression emphasizing that he has performed them thousands, even tens of thousands, of times.
findings.replacement: The martial arts I’ve performed thousands—even tens of thousands—of times feel unfamiliar.
findings.source: 천 번, 만 번도 넘게 펼친 무공이 낯설다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it loses one kinship distinction, softens an explicit reference to sexual preference, changes an emotional beat, adds dialogue, and contains several localized wording issues.
